title: Pure Dark Time Wizard
summary: The ten Dark Time Wizard cards from Beyond the Brave with generic staples. The page's four Dark Time Wizard combo lines run on this list; only the classic Thousand Dragon line needs Time Wizard and Baby Dragon. Dark Time Wizard searches any card that mentions it and comes back at the End Phase, or gambles on a coin toss to wipe the opponent's monsters. Alligator's Dragon Knight summons itself and adds two of the Spells/Traps, and Swiftwind Panther Warrior Tributes a monster to summon another from the Deck. Two Energy Shockers (one on your field or in your GY) are enough to lock the opponent's Traps.
main: Reveals a Dark Time Wizard card to summon itself; summoned, adds two Dark Time Wizard Spells/Traps and discards one.
Quick Effect: Tributes a monster to summon a Dark Time Wizard monster from the Deck, or mill a Spell/Trap.
Summoned: destroys every opposing Trap; with another Dark Time Wizard monster on your field or in your GY, their Traps are locked.
Joins when their monster acts or attacks next to a Dark Time Wizard card, destroys a monster, and returns to the hand.
Searches a card that mentions it and comes back at the End Phase, or tosses a coin to wipe their monsters and burn.
Two dice: your Dark Time Wizard monsters grow and theirs shrink; from the GY, rolls to destroy a summoned monster.
Four Sheep Tokens that shield your Dark Time Wizard cards, plus Swiftwind Panther Warrior from the Deck.
Mills a Dark Time Wizard card and revives a monster from either GY; from the GY, Sets a Spell/Trap.
Dice counters: on their monster effect or attack, calls a coin to summon a Dark Time Wizard monster and zero their monster.
extra: Summoned by Tributing a face-up monster on a turn Dark Time Wizard destroyed one; revives a Level 8 or lower monster.
